response.sql: WITH per_patient AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(APTT - PT) AS avg_diff FROM Laboratory WHERE UA > 3.9 GROUP BY ID) SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS avg_of_avg_hgb, AVG(avg_diff) AS avg_of_avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM per_patient

assumptions.assumption: APTT minus PT is computed per record, so records where either APTT or PT is null yield null and are ignored in that average. HGB is averaged separately over records with non-null HGB.
A patient whose per-patient average is null (no non-null values) is excluded from the corresponding overall average, as AVG ignores nulls.
